definitions.explanation: Something that serves as the basis or grounds for a judgment, action, or claim.
A person, thing, or idea that provides emotional or psychological support and stability.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}にして⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: Make judgments based on the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学的|かがくてき}→科学的：05677_kagakuteki⟧な{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧うのみにして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You should not blindly accept information that has no scientific basis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}だ。
examples.english: My family is my emotional anchor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧、{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{気持|きも}ちになった。
examples.english: After leaving my hometown, I felt adrift with nothing to hold on to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}になって⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: During hard times, music was a source of comfort for me.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as both a concrete basis for reasoning (sense 1) and an emotional pillar (sense 2). Often written in mixed script as {拠|よ}り{所|どころ}, though also seen in kana as よりどころ or in full kanji as {拠所|よりどころ}. The pattern ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拠|よ}り{所|どころ} (emotional anchor) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拠|よ}り{所|どころ}: emotional anchor/support
- {拠|よ}り{所|どころ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no basis / to feel adrift
- {拠|よ}り{所|どころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rely on as a foundation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧: evidence, grounds (more logical/factual)
- ⟦{支|ささ}え→支え：13038_sasae⟧: support, prop (more concrete, physical or emotional)
